qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Formulation co-development and regulatory lock-in with consumer care and pharmaceutical customers. Ingredients represent a tiny fraction of end-product cost but dictate efficacy and regulatory compliance, creating high switching costs; 5-year median ROIC is 14.2%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). While Croda possesses proprietary formulation lock-in in beauty and pharma ingredients (median ROIC 14.2%), specialty chemicals has a Tier 3 industry persistence baseline (10-15Y). Prolonged customer destocking, normalization of post-COVID mRNA vaccine lipid demand, and rising competition from Asian bio-based synthesizers impose terminal headwinds on margin durability, capping CAP at 5 years.
qualitative.evidence: Post-tax ROIC fell sharply from 14.4% in 2022 to 8.3% in 2023 and 7.7% in 2024. Operating margins contracted from ~25% to 17.2% during destocking. Discontinuation of COVID lipid contract windfalls and integration of the lower-margin Iberchem acquisition highlight cyclical vulnerability in specialty chemicals.
